title: Compilar presión real del frontier para /wc
mission: Build an executable machine-readable frontier-pressure compiler for the /wc metabolism loop. From current durable beacons, pins/claims, heartbeats, terminal returns and queue/portfolio jobs, compute distinct recent launches, target_claimable from METABOLISM_POLICY_V1, effective live owners, claimable useful work, stale/replaceable pressure and unconsumed-return triggers. Emit a reproducible snapshot consumable by allocators/Guide roles; do not infer readiness from directory existence or raw task count.
definition_of_done: The compiler implements the current 10m launch window and clamp(8, ceil(1.5 * distinct_recent_beacons), 40) target rule.
Claimable counts exclude terminal dedupe keys and live owners, and use latest durable signal for stale/recovery state.
Output explicitly reports FRONTIER_THIN/RETURNS_UNCONSUMED/REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE evidence inputs without auto-promoting product authority.
Tests include concurrent beacons, terminal returns, live heartbeat, >=10m silent owner and duplicate/dedupe cases.
A generated snapshot can be consumed by /wc or Guide allocation without manual human routing.
